content: Ntɛɛn a Ityen
Mfum a angaŋ kun'fuul naa: « Nkye ndaa ya bàkatɛɛnà yi a ngye yà ndandaa? »
Wɛɛ Ityen kàfuur naa: « Atɔŋ anà bàtaa, lan'wem. Nzam a làkoo kàyàmɛnà akà taaràbi Abàlam umpal kàkäl nde u Mɛsɔpɔtami, kusà nde mukàkal u Aran.
Waa nde kun'sam naa: "Lwomà u bul angye anà ywar angye, kyen bul alà in'yaswaŋ mɛ."
Abun, Abàlam kàlwomà u bul aba Syaldɛyɛn mukàkal u Aran. Akun, ungö a nkweel a taarànde, Nzam kàyun'tɔl u nsi làbà bɛ yi ŋàbà.
Abun, nde kun'pɛ anki akà ywaŋ mwɛy, itàkal itiir a mɛɛn, wɛɛ nde kun'pɛ ilää mukun'pà mɛɛn ande anà baan ande ungö a nkweel ande. Wɛɛ Abàlam kàkäl anki anà mwan.
Kyakin Nzam kun'kyään naa: "Ikyee ande bàsàkal u nsi a baar asin, ba bàsàbulà asɔ anà bàsatà an'kaal mbul nkam nà.
Wɛɛ mɛ in'sàtsul nsaŋ a nsi ayisàbuul ba asɔ. Ungö a indiir abi, ba bàkyer asàtoo anà bàsan'syaŋà kà ikal aki."

Ungö apan Nzam kàdi nkwà anà nde, idiim a wa kyàkäl nkyɛɛy. Kyakin Abàlam kàkyɛy nde mwan ande Izak kà ilä kyà naan ungö a mböör ande. Izak sye kàkyer abun akà Yakɔb, Yakɔb waa kàkyer akà ankum bà kwem aŋiyweel.
Ankum bàyöm mpem ntɔn Yɔsɛfi, ba bàkyer un'yälà ntɔn bun'syen Ngipiti. Wɛɛ Nzam kàkäl anà nde.
Abun, nde kun'lwom uboo a ngyɛb, waa kun'pɛ kab anà an'yeerà kusà a Falawɔ, mfum a Ngipiti, nde kun'si mfum ikikye u Ngipiti anà udu a ndwà ande yanswà.
Wɛɛ umpal ayin, ngyal mbɔɔn yàbilà u Ngipiti wanswà anà u Kanana. Ngyɛb yàkäl mbɔɔn, bàtaaràbi bàmɛnà anki isaa adyà.
Mpal kàyöb Yakɔb naa isaa byàkäl u Ngipiti, nde kàtöm bàtaaràbi u mbalà atàtwɛb.
U mbalà yàyweel, nde kàkyer naa atɔŋ ande bun'yöb, apan Falawɔ waa kàyöb ntsü kàfü Yɔsɛfi.
Ungö apan Yɔsɛfi katöm mukàbel taarànde Yakɔb anà ywar ande lanswà, ba bàkäl baar an'kwem nsambwaar aŋityeen.
Apan, Yakɔb kàtyà Ngipiti, waa kàkàkwà kwo anà bàtaaràbi,
waa basyen u Sishɛm, batɔ̈ɔ̈l uboo a an'lom kàsöm Abàlam a ngim akà baan a Amɔr, taar a Sishɛm.
Ungö apan, taaŋ kàsi Nzam ntɔn ilää kàpɛ nde akà Abàlam kyàkäl tsütsü mukwo, un'sɛŋ kàkyer ayɛl, baar bàbulà mbɔɔn u Ngipiti
tii umpal kàwɛl mfum asin imfum u Ngipiti. Nde Yɔsɛfi kàsun'yöb anki.
Mfum awà kàkür un'sɛŋ abi anà kàpɛ bànkaa abi mpay muswaŋ ba a ngwal mupiy baan a kɔɔ aba ntɔn ba bàkü.
Umpal ayin bàbör ba Mɔsɛ awà kàkäl ntwɛn mbɔɔn u mii a Nzam. Nde bun'bɔɔŋ ngɔn tär u ndwà a taarànde.
Mpal bàkun'tɔɔl ba, mwan a Falawɔ wun'kaar laa kun'wɛl nde, waa kun'ywaaŋ nkà.
Mɔsɛ bun'lɔŋ unsà an'yeerà a baar a Ngipiti manswà. Nde kàkäl un'te baal unsà ntɛɛn anà unsà nsyääl ande.
Mpal kàkölà nde mbul an'kwem an'nà, ankyän màyi u mpem ande mukàler atɔŋ ande baan a Isàlɛl.
Akun nde kàmɛn mbuur mwɛy wàmukyerà mwan a Isàlɛl mwɛy ube, nde kàwɛɛl mbuur bàkyeer ube wà, waa kàdwä Un'ngipiti wa.
Abun nde kàsii muswaŋ atɔŋ ande naa u mbwo ande Nzam kàlatswà mɔ̈ɔ̈, wɛɛ ba bàsàyöb anki.
Wɛɛ ilä kyàlääb paa, nde an'kàmɛnà akà ba mpal bàkäl ba munwan ba a ba, nde waa katsuuŋ, waa kàtɛn a ba naa: "Abaal, bɛ làbà atɔŋ, ntɔn nkye làkyerà bɛ ube bɛ a bɛ?"
Wɛɛ mbuur akwà kàkyerà un'tɔŋ ande ube kàtön Mɔsɛ, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: "Nà kasi mfum anà ntɛɛn udu a bi?
Nkye ngye akwen mukan'dwa asànaa kàdwä ngye un'ngipiti ywenà?"
Ntɔn ndaa ayi, Mɔsɛ laa kàtiin nde, waa kàkàbwaay u nsi a Madyani, mper kàbör nde baan abaal bɔ̈ɔ̈l.
Ungö a mbul an'kwem an'nà, un'kyeey mwey kàkàmɛnà akà nde u nsye a ipɔl yà mɔŋ a Sinayi uboo a làlɛm a mbaa a ibwiy.
Mpal kàmɛn Mɔsɛ abun, nde kàbem mbɔɔn ntɔn iman mii akin. Wɛɛ mpal kàsin nde tsütsü muler naa nkye ikalyaaŋà, nde kàwɛm ndaa a Mwol yàmutɛn naa:
"Mɛ in'wà Nzam a bàtaaràŋà, Nzam a Abàlam, a Izak anà wà Yakɔb." Mɔsɛ kàkyer atɛɛr a bɔɔmà, kàfàkwo anki muler.
Apan, Mwol waa kun'sam naa: "Lwoom idyaar abyà kà in'kɔl angye, ntɔn ikal awà ngye kin mà mɛɛn in'kyɛɛl.
Mɛ kàkyàman mpay a un'sɛŋ amɛ u Ngipiti anà in'tär aba. Lalan mɛ an'yàtyà ntɔn mukatsuuŋ. Kyen apanà, mɛ inkwen mukatɔm u Ngipiti."
Mɔsɛ awà, ba bàkyer un'tɔn, waa bàtɛn a nde naa: "Nà kasi mfum anà ntɛɛn?" Nzam kàkyer un'tɔm asànaa mfum anà ntɛɛn, u mbwo a un'kyeey akwà kàyamɛnà akà nde uboo a ibwiy.
Nde mbuur awà kàtwey baan a Isàlɛl, mukyer impà anà idiim u Ngipiti, u ngyäl a tsöö anà u nsye a ipɔl mbul an'kwem an'nà.
Mɔsɛ nsil awà kàtɛn a baan a Isàlɛl naa: "Nzam ayàtwey ŋangɔɔm mwɛy asànaa mɛ uboo a atɔŋ abɛ."
Mbuur nsil awà, utaaŋ a nköŋ u nsye a ipɔl, nde kàkäl nkalsà a bànkaa abi anà un'kyeey akwà kàtɛɛnà a nde udu a mɔŋ a Sinayi, nde mbuur kàwɛlà ndaa a mɔ̈ɔ̈ ntɔn mupà akà bi.
Wɛɛ bànkaa abi bàkwen anki mukun'wem, ba bàkyer un'tɔn, an'kyän aba màfurà Ngipiti.
Abun, ba bàtɛn a Alɔn naa: "Ikyeer bànzam bàyàkal kusà abi, ntɔn bi iyöb anki naa Mɔsɛ akwà kà itwey u Ngipiti nkye kan'bulà."
Apan, ba bàkyer un'tö a ngɔɔmà, waa bàpɛɛ ibɔɔn akà wa, bàyakyerà un'kyɔm a indiir bàkyerà ba a an'kɔɔ aba.
Wɛɛ Nzam kapɛ ngö, waa kawɛy musyäŋà indiir a du, asànaa bàsön uboo a un'kaan a aŋangɔɔm naa: "In'sɛŋ a Isàlɛl, nkye kà akà mɛ anki

content.text: bɛ làpɛɛ ntsür anà ibɔɔn asin
mbul an'kwem an'nà u nsye a ipɔl?
Wɛɛ bɛ làbwäär ntɛn a Mɔlɔk
anà mbwaar a nzam abɛ Rɛfan,
abi itɛk làkyer bɛ ntɔn bɛ làsyeel bya làkoo.
Kyakin, mɛ in'sàkàlasà asɔ lyaaŋ Babilɔn."

content: U nsye a ipɔl bànkaa abi bàkäl anà ntɛn a imbäl. Mbuur kàyäämà a Mɔsɛ kun'swɛŋ naa nde ukyer wa asànaa idiim kàmɛn nde.
Umpal bàwɛl bàtaa abi ya, ba anà Yɔswa bàbiil ya u mɛɛn a in'sɛŋ kàböŋ Nzam kusà aba. Ya yàkäl kwo tii upaŋà a David.
David kàwɛl kab angway akà Nzam, waa kàlɔ̈m akà nde ikal mutɔŋ ndwà in'kyɛɛl ntɔn ywar a Yakɔb.
Wɛɛ mbuur kun'tööŋ ndwà Salɔmun.
Wɛɛ Nzam a dudu afàbɔ̈ɔ̈n anki u ndwà bàtöŋ baar kà an'kɔɔ aba, asànaa kàtɛn nde u mun a ŋangɔɔm naa:

content.text: mɛɛn mà ikal in'fàsà mɛ in'kɔl amɛ.
Ndwà nà bɛ lan'kwo mutööŋ mɛ?
Itàkal naa ikal nà mɛ an'kwo muyöör?
Nkye kà an'kɔɔ amɛ anki màkyer indiir abi byanswà?"
Bɛ, baar a ibway aŋàbwà un'sey, mpa bàkyɛy mpem anà an'tsü, bɛ làfàmbäär Dweelà In'kyɛɛl taaŋ lanswà! Bɛ, bɛ làbà asànaa bànkaa abɛ.
Uboo a aŋangɔɔm banswà, nà bànkaa abɛ mpa bàmɛɛy nkwaaŋ? Ba bàdwä baar abà bàkyäänà kusà a ngyeel a mbuur a balàbal mwɛy mpɛl. Wɛɛ ŋàbawà bɛ, bɛ làmun'yälà anà làmun'dwa.
Bɛ baar làwɛl un'kɔɔn u mbwo a akyeey, wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ wa làfàlab anki! »

content: Nkweel a Ityen
Mpal bàwem ba indiir abi, un'fur a nkyɛl kàwɛl mpem aba, waa bàkwoorà an'din.
Wɛɛ nde, nde kàkäl aŋàyɔl a Dweelà In'kyɛɛl, waa kàsyebà du, kàmɛn làkoo a Nzam anà Yɛsu kàkyàbwaay u kɔɔ a Nzam là ibaal.
Waa kàtɛn naa: « Làler, mɛ in'wàmumanà an'du màŋàduub, Mwan a mbuur wàŋàbwaay u kɔɔ a Nzam là ibaal. »
Apan, ba bàsi in'kwɛŋ, waa bàdübà an'tsü. Ba banswà waa bun'bürà,
bun'syen u nsà a bul, waa bun'kämà in'kul. Ambäl ipfɛy aba bàtɔ̈ɔ̈là kà in'kɔl a mwan baal mwɛy ikɔb ande Sɔl.
Mpal bàkäl ba mukun'lomà in'kul, Ityen kàyamà naa: « Mwol Yɛsu, wal dweelà amɛ! »
Apan, nde kàbü an'köm, waa kàlaal: « Mwol, twon an'tälà buur a ube bà udu a ba! » Ungö mutɛn abà, nde waa kàkü.
